about.title: Head Swim Coach
about.bio: From first-time age-groupers to competitive high school and club swimmers, I focus on the stroke technique and race intelligence that turn hard work into fast times. Every swimmer I coach understands not just how to swim, but why they're swimming it that way.

hero.headline: Train the Stroke. Win the Race.
hero.subline: Private swim coaching — stroke development, starts and turns, and race strategy for swimmers who want to drop time and compete at the next level.

services.title: Stroke Development
services.description: Freestyle, backstroke, breaststroke, and butterfly — technique sessions targeting body position, pull mechanics, kick timing, and breathing.

services.title: Starts & Turns
services.description: Race starts, flip turns, and underwater dolphin kicks — the often-overlooked phases where significant time can be gained.

services.title: Race Strategy & Recruiting
services.description: Pacing plans, split strategies, and taper guidance for competitive swimmers. Recruiting profile guidance for college-bound athletes.

testimonials.quote: My daughter dropped 4 seconds in her 100 free in one season. The work on her flip turns and underwaters made a huge difference.
testimonials.name: Angela B.

testimonials.quote: My breaststroke technique was completely broken. After a few sessions, I rebuilt it and dropped almost 3 seconds at my next meet.
testimonials.name: Noah K.

success_stories.name: Emma T.
success_stories.story: Emma had a strong freestyle but her butterfly was limiting her IM performance. We spent the fall rebuilding her butterfly mechanics and her underwater dolphin kick timing.
success_stories.result: State Qualifier · IM Time Drop 6 sec · College Scholarship

faq.question: What age groups do you coach?
faq.answer: I work with swimmers from age 6 through college level. Sessions are designed for your current stroke development and goals.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Sessions take place at local pool facilities in the area. Location is confirmed at booking.

faq.question: How long are sessions?
faq.answer: In-water sessions run 60 minutes. Video analysis sessions can be added to any lesson.

faq.question: What should my swimmer bring?
faq.answer: Competition or training suit, goggles, swim cap, and water. Fins and pull buoys are provided.

faq.question: Can you work alongside my swimmer's club program?
faq.answer: Yes — individual sessions are designed to complement club training, not conflict with it. I coordinate with coaches on request.
